thread:
maria: sharing the final OKR draft for Q3 — incorporated exec feedback. please review and flag any must-change by EOD tomorrow. link: https://redwood.app/okrs/q3-draft

maria: quick context: we reduced scope on two infra bets and added a dependency on hiring an infra PM. see section 3 for tradeoffs.

jon: skimmed it. overall strong. one concern: the latency SLO for Dedicated customers looks optimistic given current routing work. either drop the SLO or move routing to stretch.

vivian: +1 on jon. "sub-ms routing" is a 2-sprint effort. propose we move that to stretch, keep cache priming & KV cache improvements in committed.

ryan: from finance: if routing moves to stretch, adjust the opex savings from 18% -> 12%. also need a note about expected infra credits for pilot customers.

sasha: people-ops note — infra PM req is still open. hiring delay would push rollout ~3 weeks. do we want a contingency plan? (temp contractor, or shift deadlines)

maria: proposed decision: commit core product OKRs as-is, move "sub-ms routing" to stretch, update cost projection to 12%, and mark infra PM hire as a dependency with contingency = "contractor". any objections?

jon: +1

vivian: +1. also recommend we call out a customer pilot (AcmeCorp) to validate perf before full rollout.

maria: adding acceptance criteria to the doc now:
```
- Perf: p95 latency <= 120ms for 95% of requests
- Cost: unit token cost <= $0.0006
- Reliability: 99.95% uptime across regions
- Rollout: pilot with 2 customers, then canary, then prod
- Eval: automated prompt-set regression checks at each deploy
```

maria: @jon @vivian @ryan @sasha tagging you to confirm blockers are captured.

okr-bot: registering decision: move "sub-ms routing" -> stretch; cost adj -> 12%; dependency -> infra PM hiring (contingency: contractor).

okr-bot: decision saved. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/okrs/pulls/4820

sasha: noted. people-ops will fast-track the req for infra PM and approve contractor contract if hire slips.

ryan: finance: approve updated numbers pending final headcount confirmation. we'll process budget holdbacks accordingly.

maria: final signoff? I'll collect any last comments and then lock the OKRs into the master doc by EOD.

jon: signed off.

vivian: signed off.

ryan: signed off.

sasha: signed off.

maria: thanks everyone — locking OKRs and publishing to company. :tada:
